publicEvidence: Record each public recipient plus SHA256 of recipient string, purpose, run id and distinctness; never hash/export private contents for evidence

semantics.rawObservation: actual SOPS decrypt process status/stdout metadata; expected failure not a Policy input
semantics.frozenSource: secrets-gate.mjs spawnSync(sops,decrypt) and r.status!==0 throw; not executed now

cleanup: Stop all child processes; remove mounts; delete both exact private/public files; confirm absence and no open handles; no archives/backups/commits of key material
approval: Second independent disposable negative-only pair explicitly approved by current attachment; no production contract change
